rows.name: ? block 16x16 tile-id entry (top-left/bottom-left/top-right/bottom-right = $53 $55 $54 $56)
rows.notes: PRG ROM source of the ? block's four 8x8 quadrant tile ids. Bytes at prgRom 0xC8C..0xC8F are 53 55 54 56 (= nametable tiles $53 top-left, $55 bottom-left, $54 top-right, $56 bottom-right, i.e. column-major). A second identical 4-byte entry follows immediately at 0xC90 (a different block object reuses the same graphics). The blocks sit in the block/2x2-graphics table that runs roughly prgRom 0x6E7B-0xCA3 (4-byte 2x2 tile groups) and ends just before the area-palette block at 0xCA4. Proof (search and ledgered write): read_nametable showed the World 1-1 block quadrants as 83/85/84/86; write_memory prgRom 0xC8C = $24 (sky) with a reason (ledger seq 1), reset_emulator, pressed Start twice and walked right 150 frames; the screenshot showed the ? block(s) missing their top-left quadrant (rendered as an L/J-shaped corner) while the pixel passed through to the green hill, and one row block that uses the 0xC90 copy stayed intact; undo_edit restored 0x53.

rows.name: small Mario standing-frame tile list ($3A $37 $4F $4F plus four $FC blank cells)
rows.notes: PRG ROM source of small Mario's standing sprite tiles, in the player pose-graphics table at prgRom 0x6E7B-0x6EE8 (8-byte entries, immediately before the player-graphics routine at 0x6EE9). The entry at prgRom 0x6ED3 holds 3A 37 4F 4F FC FC FC FC: the four visible 8x8 cells of small Mario standing (top row $3A head-left, $37 head-right; bottom row $4F body, $4F body h-flipped) plus four $FC blank cells the handler emits above him. list_sprites on a standing small Mario gave palette-4 OAM tiles 252,252 / 252,252 / 58,55 / 79,79 at x=40/48, which matches. Proof (search and ledgered write): write_memory prgRom 0x6ED3 = $FC with a reason (ledger seq 1), reset_emulator, pressed Start twice; the screenshot still showed small Mario standing but with the upper-left head quadrant missing - list_sprites then reported that OAM cell as tile $FC (was $3A) and get_pixel_color at (44,197) showed the green hill ($1A) where his orange skin had been, while (52,197) stayed $27 orange; undo_edit restored 0x3A.
